### a) Bio-degradable Product
Leather is fundamentally a protein-based matrix (collagen) derived from animal hides. When discarded, unlike synthetic alternatives (like polyurethane or PVC artificial leather which persist for centuries), leather naturally decomposes under the action of soil microorganisms, moisture, and enzymes into harmless organic components, making it environmentally sustainable.

### b) Curing
Curing is the immediate preservation process applied to freshly flayed raw hides and skins to prevent bacterial decomposition and putrefaction during storage and transport. Common methods include **salting** (applying sodium chloride to lower moisture via osmosis) and **brining** (immersing in concentrated salt solutions).
